description.value: Timothy's is a Steveston waterfront institution that has been producing small-batch Italian gelato in-house since 1989, when it was the only establishment on the historic Steveston Pier. The shop sources ingredients locally where possible and offers an extensive roster of classic and original gelato and sorbetto flavours. Located at Steveston Landing, it sits at the centre of one of Richmond's most-cycled waterfront areas.
